service.title: Services
service.first-description: Our highly qualified team performs ethical penetration tests to identify vulnerabilities in clients' systems, applications, and infrastructure. We use advanced ethical hacking techniques to evaluate clients' security levels and provide recommendations to strengthen their security.
service.second-description: We conduct thorough audits to evaluate our clients' risk levels. This includes analyzing policies, procedures, system configurations, and employee training to ensure their organization's security.
service.third-description: We provide cloud infrastructure consulting, helping clients not only configure their infrastructure properly to reduce costs but also make it more secure.
service.fourth-description: The core principle of DevSecOps is integrating security into every phase of development, from planning to deployment. This ensures that security is not an additional step but a natural part of the workflow for development and operations teams, resulting in more secure and resilient applications from the start.

faq.title: Frequently Asked Questions
faq.description: Find answers to the most common questions about how TROYSEC can help protect and strengthen your company's security.
faq.first-question: Can TROYSEC help me obtain certifications like ISO 9001?
faq.second-question: What benefits do I gain from conducting a pentesting audit with TROYSEC?
faq.third-question: How can TROYSEC improve my company's cybersecurity?
faq.fourth-question: What is a compliance audit, and how can it benefit me?
faq.fifth-question: Does TROYSEC offer incident response services?
faq.sixth-question: What sets TROYSEC apart from other cybersecurity companies?
faq.first-answer: Yes, at TROYSEC, we have experts who will guide you through the entire preparation process for obtaining important certifications such as ISO 9001, ISO 27001 (Information Security Management), and PCI DSS (Payment Card Industry Data Security Standards). Our team advises you on meeting requirements, implementing security controls, and preparing the necessary documentation, ensuring your company is fully ready to obtain and maintain these critical certifications.
faq.second-answer: By conducting a pentesting audit with TROYSEC, you can identify and fix errors, vulnerabilities, and security flaws in your systems before malicious attackers can exploit them. This not only protects your infrastructure but also prevents potential financial losses and damage to your company's reputation.
faq.third-answer: TROYSEC offers a comprehensive approach to improving your company's cybersecurity, including risk assessments, implementing advanced protective measures, and training your staff to be prepared for any threat. Our goal is to strengthen all aspects of security, from the perimeter to internal protection.
faq.fourth-answer: A compliance audit conducted by TROYSEC helps ensure your company complies with all applicable regulations and standards in your sector. This not only protects you from potential legal sanctions but also strengthens your customers' and business partners' trust by demonstrating that you handle their data responsibly and securely.
faq.fifth-answer: Yes, at TROYSEC, we have a specialized incident response team available to act quickly in the event of a security breach. Our team will help contain the incident, mitigate the damage, and restore the security of your environment as swiftly as possible.
faq.sixth-answer: At TROYSEC, we stand out for our personalized and tailored approach to each client's specific needs. We don't just offer cybersecurity solutions; we work closely with your team to ensure the measures implemented seamlessly integrate into your daily operations and provide maximum value.
